body: Territory membership = district of the nearest city block curb polygon (0 inside a block), not Voronoi of district seed points: matches how blocks were assigned and how T12 will paint territory; probe 3.3 us per call, 140 CCW convex blocks in seed 1.

Gang spawner lives in population/ (GDD 12: bubble, spawn/despawn, caps) as population/gangs.rs, runs after spawn_civilians and spends only the ray budget civilians left in PopulationLoad; alternative (own budget knob) rejected as a second source for one limit.

Gangs roll from their own ChaCha stream (GangRng, stream 2) and do not change civilians' spawn separation: any extra NpcRng draw or candidate filter shifts the civilian sequence and the fragile street_ahead density gate (seed-1 route enters gang 0 turf). Alternative: include gang bodies in civilians' taken list - rejected, group spots sit 1 m around corner nodes and never overlap a civilian spawn point.

Provocation reads ShotFired (muzzle within shot_radius, muzzle in the gang's territory) and DamageDealt (any hit on a member, self-defence regardless of territory), filtered by the faction matrix; alternative literal reading (nothing provokes outside the territory) goes to Open questions with this as default.

Gang members carry Perception only for its AI slot (LOS every slots ticks); civilian perceive/collect_stimuli filter on Civilian so they ignore gang members. Alternative own slot cursor rejected as a duplicate of assign_slot.

A* for gang chase runs synchronously inside gang_fsm, capped at navigation.ron route_requests_per_tick searches per fixed tick (GDD s11 queue-K rule), instead of AsyncComputeTaskPool markers: seed-1 probe measured pathfinding 4.16.0 astar at 11 us mean / 95 us worst over the whole sidewalk graph, 0.5 us for pairs under 60 m.

gang_death goes into HealthSystems::Death + NpcSystems (civilian_death precedent), not into GangSystems and not PlayingSystems as PLAN_V2 prescribed; V2's schedule-cycle diagnosis does not hold (civilian_death already sits in Death + NpcSystems while NpcSystems' Perceive/Decide are after Death), its constraint 'not in GangSystems' is kept.

QA/test fixture 'player on the gang-0 post 50-70 m (or 50-80 m) from the HQ' from PLAN.md: seed-1 probe shows gang 0 posts at 44.1, 46.2 then 104.6 m from the HQ post, so the fixture would be GATE BROKEN; replaced by 'nearest non-HQ post whose HQ distance lies in spawn_ring' (44.1 m).

GangMember gains sees_focus: Option<Entity>; line of sight is refreshed at once (off-slot) when the focus entity changes, else on the AI slot. Alternative: slot-only refresh as planned - rejected: a freshly provoked member has sees=false for up to 3 ticks and routes (A* search) toward a target in clear view, breaking the searches==0 direct-seek gate.

TurfBlock keeps citygen::Vec2 curb points and is #[reflect(ignore)] inside GangTerritories (not registered). Alternative: bevy Vec2 + Reflect as planned - rejected: citygen uses glam 0.32.1, bevy glam 0.33.8, so contains_convex/dist_point_segment would need a per-query conversion or a copy of the geometry.

Planned flip 'drop the gang filter in provoke_gangs -> R RED' in attack_on_a_member_aggroes_the_group_within_30m stays GREEN: the wrongly aggroed gang-1 member is released by gang_fsm in the same tick (target is the player, GangHeat[1] == 0). Replaced by an assertion in the matrix-on punch half (the attacker's own gang is never set on it), which goes RED.

Gang tint gate in the plain GLB harness: glTF meshes carry no MeshMaterial3d<StandardMaterial> without PbrPlugin (its glTF extension handler makes them), so on_model_ready had nothing to tint. Fixed in the test by a stand-in GltfExtensionHandler plus register_type::<MeshMaterial3d<StandardMaterial>>().

Held-gun gate 'Inherited after exactly 1 update' was flaky (1 of ~6 full-suite runs): a model's children (hand joint + HeldGun) are sometimes replaced one update after the model was wired, the root entity stays. The gate now waits for the state (<= 8 updates) and asserts never more than one gun per owner.

Review issue 1 (30 FPS) is not a frame-cost defect: one winit monitor \.\DISPLAY9 at 30000 mHz, window Fifo; AutoNoVsync at the HQ pose gives 2.4-2.6 ms/frame with gangs off (max_gang_members 0), 2.35-2.64 ms idle and 2.36-2.47 ms in a live firefight with gangs on. No optimisation done; the t8/t9 FPS readout now reports monitor refresh, present mode and a no-vsync frame cost (brp.py frame_report).

Held-gun gate as the review prescribed ('exactly one gun on every update after first success', 'same hand afterwards') is flaky on correct code: in the headless GLB harness WorldAsset LoadedWithDependencies/Modified events keep arriving while scenes stream in, re-instancing models and debouncing a forced Modified; after a re-instance the gun is missing one update and Hidden one more (attach_held_gun/show_held_gun unordered, also in production). Gate now settles 4 quiet updates, forces a re-instance with retry, and asserts a drawn gun is never unseen for more than 2 consecutive updates.

Gang presentation gates moved from civilian_gate.rs (would be 787 lines, over the 750 warning) into src/visuals/gang_gate.rs, as PLAN_FINAL step 24 prescribed for that case; shared GLB-harness helpers became pub(super). Alternative: keep one 787-line file in the warning band - rejected, the plan named the split.

t9.py raises the player's armour to 1e6 over BRP right before the provoking shot (named QA mutation) and captures firefight.png at the first poll where the player is alive, a member attacks and a member has spent a round; a missing capture fails the run. Alternative: capture sooner without armour - rejected, the seed-1 group killed the player within ~3 s and the timing is BRP-latency dependent.

Friendly fire measured two ways: headless DamageDealt log (shooter and target both members, 6 layouts x 30 s, production composition) and at runtime by member Health after the single sky shot (the player never fires again, so any member health drop is a groupmate's bullet). Alternative: read DamageDealt over BRP - rejected, buffered messages are not BRP-queryable.

Friendly-fire hold-fire check limited to the aim segment up to the target still let a miss hit a groupmate standing behind the player (ring4 layout, headshot at z=+1.36); a stateless 'step to the cheaper side' dithered between two close groupmates (yaw flipped every ~6 ticks, SMG fired 0-3 times in 30 s). Final: check to weapon range, side committed in GangMember.sidestep until the line clears.

Friendly fire fixed in gang_fsm (hold fire/punch + sidestep while a non-hostile living Character is in the line widened by capsule radius + fire_line_margin + spread cone), not in fire_weapons (QA option b: skipping same-faction bodies in the shared hitscan predicate). Melee included because the committed gate counts every DamageDealt and out-of-ammo members punched each other.

Hold-fire liveness measured per member as longest gap between ShotFired and seconds with GangMember.sidestep != 0 (headless, 30 s, own layouts incl. bystander dummies/civilians behind the player and out-of-ammo scrums) and at runtime by rounds spent + sidestep over BRP; alternative (only total shots >= 8 as in the committed gate) rejected: it hides a member that never fires while groupmates do.

Candidate spots re-picked from scratch on every AI slot flipped a member between the two sides in place (pistol walking at 1.5 m/s with 0 net motion, 5 shots in 30 s); a walk check against every body within 2 radii rejected all spots of a member touching its neighbour (0.6 m apart), so both closed in to the player. Final: keep the spot while still usable, re-pick only when it fails; a body blocks the walk only if the walk gets closer to it.

Gang punches spare non-hostile characters in combat::apply_strikes (GangConfig::spares on the attacker/target Faction at impact), not by a pull-time line check in gang_fsm (round 2) and not by skipping bodies in swing_melee's sweep. Consequence: the matrix-off punch of disabled_matrix_gangs_do_not_attack_each_other now yields no DamageDealt; its half 1 asserts the fist met B (Swing.landed) with zero damage instead of a DamageDealt precondition.

STOP per the round-3 orchestrator note: layout 'fist scrum flank, player stands' still starves the gunman (2 shots / 30 s) because two brawlers 1.56 m from the target block every line beyond ~2.5 m; kept as an #[ignore]d gate (gunman_behind_a_flanking_fist_scrum_keeps_firing) and reported with simpler-rule options instead of adding a spiral/orbit fallback. Alternative rejected: patch the fallback further (TASK-018/019 lesson).

Option (a) read literally (a blocker yields when it is a groupmate engaged with the same target, anywhere) pinned distant gunmen blocking each other: 4 gang_fire_lines gates RED (west pair + groupmate east Smg 0, surround4 mixed j0 Smg 0, tie-break never picked a spot). Close-in is what clears gunman-vs-gunman lines.

A shield yields (pins the gunman to its keep_distance band) when it is pressed against the target, within combat.melee_distance.1, whatever its faction; chosen over 'engaged groupmate anywhere' (G6 flip RED on 5 gates). Covers the brawler and the human shield with no new data field.

'fist scrum inline, player stands' moved from per-member MIN_SHOTS to the group-pressure gate: past a body 1.56 m off the target every SMG line is blocked beyond ~5.4 m, inside the 8 m band edge, so rule (a) forbids the only way it fired in round 3; alternative (keep per-member gate, weaken the rule) rejected per the binding OPEN_DECISIONS liveness definition.

Tie-break checked against an independent re-statement of the line test (0.5 m + along*tan(aim_error+base+max_bloom), flat, weapon range) computed per tick from positions, counting ticks where both lines are mutually blocked and the higher index moves; alternative (the gate's proxy: higher index has no reposition and zero axis for 48 ticks) rejected because it cannot tell a tie-break violation from a legitimate non-mutual move (T1r: 74 such ticks, 0 in mutual ticks).

Expected a bystander 2.4 m beside the player (inside the 2.5 m yielding radius) to pin two SMG gunmen at 12 m for the whole fight (hand computation: every candidate spot line blocked); measured 32/33 shots, the gunmen found lines. Hand geometry over the candidate spots is not a substitute for running the layout.
